title: Doctor descendant-deadline tests assert the teardown mechanism but not the temp-root removal it protects
outcome: check_doctor_descendant_deadline (src/tests/engram_host_adapter.rs) observes its TestTempRoot's removal and asserts it succeeded, using root.observe_cleanup() and an Ok receipt, as src/tests/test_temp_paths.rs already does. A regression of the teardown ordering then fails this test by name. Today it is caught only by scripts/test-temp-root.mjs's end-of-run residual check, which fails the whole green run without naming the race. The test asserts the mechanism (the launching process is in the awaited set) but not the outcome.
acceptance: Both doctor descendant-deadline tests assert that their temp root was removed (an Ok cleanup receipt) after the fixture tree exited.
A deliberately unawaited fixture process makes the test itself fail, naming the root that could not be removed.
